answer: Each agent ID gets a per-epoch prompt seeded with its own address, and peers attest only answers that pass a similarity check against every other submission. A farm with 200 fakes must pay for 200 distinct pieces of work every epoch. Paraphrasing one draft leaves a dune of near-identical text that embedding distance clusters, and the cluster's payouts get voided. Rewards sit in a vault until the anchor block closes the epoch, so flagged IDs never get paid.
